dct_title_s: Partie Meridionale D'Afrique ou ſe trouvent la Basse Guinée, la Cafrerie, le Monomotapa, le Monomugi, le Zanguebar et l'Isle de Madagascar
dct_description_sm: Legend states the discovery of the Cape of Good Hope by Bartholomew Diaz in 1486. Cartouche includes a galleon and a whale.

Norwich, I., Pam Kolbe, and Jeffrey C Stone. Norwich's Maps of Africa: An Illustrated and Annotated Carto-Bibliography. 2nd ed. / rev. and edited by Jeffrey C. Stone. Norwich, Vt.: Terra Nova Press, 1997, map 0167, p. 190
David Rumsey Map Center copy 1: Norwich no. NOR 0167.
